# #128 — Require rtech-hermes Python OpenBrain runtime contract validation

## Problem
Hermes agents use a direct Python OpenBrain runtime/plugin path, not just mcp2cli. That runtime must prove compatibility with hosted Open Brain every time it starts; otherwise it can silently drift from the real server contract.

## Dependency
Depends on #127 for the canonical Open Brain contract source.

## Scope
Coordinate and verify the rtech-hermes Python implementation:
- packages/rtech-hermes-runtime/src/rtech_hermes_runtime/openbrain/
- plugins/memory/openbrain/
- tests/plugins/memory/
- packages/rtech-hermes-runtime/tests/test_openbrain_*

## Requirements
- Add a Python contract check against hosted/staged Open Brain.
- Validate contract_version/schema_hash/capabilities/min client version.
- Fail closed and loudly when incompatible or unreachable in required mode.
- Do not fall back to local memory or any legacy memory path.
- Add fake-transport tests and an env-gated live/staged canary.

## Acceptance Criteria
- rtech-hermes provider startup refuses incompatible Open Brain contracts.
- Contract mismatch is visible in logs/status.
- Open Brain downstream rollout is not complete until this check passes for opted-in Hermes agents.
